messages.content: Interesting — let me process what you're looking for here.
I see — you want me to create a visual visualization. Let me figure out the best tool for this.
I've outlined 7 steps. Kicking off code generation...

I'm writing code for a rotating turbine geometry, a stator with wireframe coil windings, animated tube geometries for magnetic flux lines that pulse, and a particle system with glowing sprites that accelerate along curved paths representing electrical current.
Spinning up the Three.js renderer with post-processing bloom for those electric glows, enabling shadow maps for the turbine blades, and starting the animation loop.

I've built an interactive 3D visualization showing a turbine converting wind or water power into rotation, driving a generator where magnetic fields induce current visualized as streams of glowing particles flowing through transmission wires.
I hit an error in the pipeline. Here are the details...
